OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
WRITING SUB-TEST:                   MEDICINE
TIME ALLOWED:                  READING TIME : 5 MINUTES
                               WRITING TIME : 45 MINUTES
Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:
You are a plastic surgeon at Newtown Hospital. Doris White a 64 years woman.


Patient: Doris White
Adress: 5 Woods St, Stillwater, Newtown city
D.O.B. 01.04.1955
Social history: lives alone with her cat
Independent use frame
On social service registry ( for laundry and cleaning ) Good mental health
Past medical history: type 2 diabetes
Chronic renal failure on regular haemodialysis Ischaemic heart disease ,
hypertension
Peripheral vascular disease , hyperpigmented skin area
Medications: Aspirin 75 mg once
Atorvastatin 40 mg once
Insulin 50 iu 2 times
Beta blockers 5mg 2 times
Linezolid 600mg
 
Nitroglycrin 4mg PND

Calcium 300 mg 2 times

Multivitamins 2 tablets

25/03/2019
Hospital admission, neglected traumatic leg injury (slip in bathroom)
Treated with analgesics (paracetamol), antibiotic (amoxicillin) and topical
pressure therapy

10/04/2019
Unhealed wound , so surgical debridement done Ankle Brachial index = 60

17/04/2019
No improvement
Skin graft with flap under general anaesthesia. 25/04/2019
Graft healing 40% ( with epithelium growth ) Wound is hyperbaric oxygen.
ABI = 70

03/05/2019
Graft healing 50%
Negative pressure dressings used.

18/05/2019
Graft healing 70% ,so plan for discharge. ABI = 70
Plan : discharge
Attach list of meds

Writing task
Using the information in the case notes, write a letter to Mrs Lucy Walters ,
a Community Nurse , requesting for wound dressing. Address the letter to
Mrs Lucy Walters, Newtown Nurse Clinic, 10 Stillwater St, Newtown.
